scope: Top-level events 99–108 in current EVENTS order
rules: Old GPX files remain valid until a new official replacement is published, downloaded, parsed and validated.
Do not delete or replace historical GPX files during this audit.
An official map or GPX button is not proof of a technically validated binary.

events.name: Adamello Ultra Trail
events.note: Important update from 17 Nov 2026 press release: 2027 event 24–26 September, four distances. Adamello Series side event begins 12 September. Previous checkpoint saying no 2027 edition is superseded.

events.name: Nice Côte d’Azur by UTMB
events.note: Official statement confirms exceptional continuation of the 2026 edition after municipal funding withdrawal; no official 2027 announcement found. FAQ says GPX normally appears 1–2 weeks before race, but that does not establish a 2027 edition.

events.name: Alpin Team Trailrun
events.note: Keep existing 2026 tracks historical; do not treat them as 2027 files.

events.name: Chihuahua by UTMB
events.note: Current race page displays 2–3 October 2026 and six 2026 formats; no 2027 edition confirmed. Preserve 2026 data as historical.

events.name: Trail & Tarmac Pursuit
events.note: 2027 edition confirmed, St. Gallen to St. Moritz, 240–270 km, 6 checkpoints, 44-hour limit. Five checkpoints released in advance; sixth secret checkpoint is revealed 30 minutes before start. Teams must plan their own route, so there is no single official GPX.

events.name: Oberaudorf Trail Festival
events.note: Official 2027 event page confirms 30 Sep–3 Oct, five distances 12K, 21K, 42K, 60K and new 100K. Individual OTF100 page gives 104.5 km / 4,992 hm; Sudelfeld page gives 42.8 km / 2,395 hm. Do not invent missing per-course metrics.

events.name: Taubertal 100
events.note: Do not confuse Taubertal 100 with the separate Taubertal Trail 2027 event. A similarly named Taubertal Trail page offers 2027 GPX, but it is a different race and must not be attached to this database entry.

events.name: HOKA Kodiak Ultra Marathons by UTMB
events.date: 2027 event registration announced; exact race date/course files not yet confirmed
events.note: Official registration page says 2027 registration will open soon and confirms event status as UTMB World Series Major. Older course files must not be assumed current.

events.name: München Marathon
events.note: Official 2026 course page shows 11 October 2026 and 42.195 km. Munich tourism page explicitly says 2027 date, race programme and route are not yet confirmed. No 2027 GPX.

events.name: StundenRundenLauf / Chiemgauer 100
events.note: 2026 edition is completed. Do not treat 6.7 km / approx. 58 hm as a current 2027 track without a new organizer announcement.

followUps: Adamello: replace old 'no 2027 edition' status with confirmed 24–26 September 2027 and four official distances; request/verify current GPX.
Nice, Alpin Team and Chihuahua: keep 2027 status unconfirmed; no old course GPX reused.
Trail & Tarmac: route must be planned individually after checkpoints appear; no single official GPX exists.
Oberaudorf: extract the remaining three course metrics and direct GPX endpoints from official participant pages.
Taubertal 100: confirm exact date and 2027 GPS files; do not confuse with Taubertal Trail.
Kodiak: recheck race pages once 2027 course details are published.
München Marathon: wait for official 2027 date, programme and GPX.
StundenRundenLauf: recheck after organizer announces next edition.
